action_summary: Restored the v13 ensemble configuration, which had the best leaderboard score: both raw-EEG model families (new_distil + new_fold with EegModel0, baseline_eeg_diff with EegModel1) are loaded and run again without the flip TTA that hurt in v14. Instead of discarding the new spectrogram model, it is kept as a diversifying ensemble member with a small weight (0.15 vs 0.85 for the averaged EEG families), since on its own it scored much worse (0.439 vs 0.302). Added NaN/inf cleaning for the spectrogram input, and clipped final probabilities to a 1e-4 floor before renormalizing to avoid unbounded KL penalties. Removed the per-prediction debug printing.
